# G10 Fulfillment

G10 Fulfillment is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. G10 Fulfillment is a logistics company that offers e-commerce fulfillment, retail fulfillment, hazmat fulfillment, wholesale fulfillment, and same day shipping services. They provide custom capabilities and integrations, as well as channelpoint and edi solutions. G10 Fulfillment employs 93 people (+22.4% YoY, +17 people), founded in 2009. Headquartered in Delavan, Wisconsin, United States, with offices in Twin Lakes, Phoenix, Summerville, Sparks, and Tolleson.

## About

At G10 Fulfillment, we help growing brands scale smarter.

With over 1.5 million sq. ft. of warehouse space and a presence across key U.S. markets, G10 offers a full suite of fulfillment services designed to support both DTC and B2B operations. From Amazon FBA prep and retail fulfillment to wholesale distribution and custom kitting, we provide the infrastructure, technology, and hands-on support to help you streamline logistics and exceed customer expectations.

# GT ONE LOGISTICS

GT ONE LOGISTICS is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. GT ONE LOGISTICS employs 4 people, founded in 2021. Headquartered in Newark, New Jersey, United States.

## About

GT ONE LOGISTICS has built its foundation providing superior home delivery services. Our focus on 3PL recruiting the best delivery specialists in the market and maintaining quality equipment ensures we will be on time and look good. 
From simple deliveries to complex staging and white glove deliveries, GT ONE LOGISTICS is the first choice for customers who want to extend their brand values through the home delivery experience. 

GT ONE LOGISTICS provides warehousing, distribution and cross-dock options as a strategic complement to our transportation and delivery services. We can arrange a customized solution based on your unique business needs such as distribution, general storage/warehousing/workspace, moving company/furniture storage, contractor storage, retail storage, e-commerce fulfillment, and repair/production/manufacturing space. Our secure facilities provide the flexibility, responsiveness, reliability and personal touch to optimize product flow and improve storage and inventory requirements.
We use our network to help customers manage their goods most efficiently throughout their supply chains. At the top of our value proposition is an intense customer service culture that connects our team nationwide. Our people focus on finding new ways to help our customers succeed, while becoming continuously more efficient ourselves. 

Customer relationships are the lifeline of our business.
